ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixel ratio is approximately 9:1 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous white region occupying the central and inferior fluke segments; narrow, irregular low-intensity dark band along the superior trailing edge perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 50 degrees and a vertical depth comprising ~18% of the visible vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations with multiple micro-peaks and valleys (~5-15 pixel variance) along the continuous dark trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves fitted to both the left and right distal trailing edges, tapering to acute, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct low-intensity pixel clusters observed on the distal right lobe and scattered along the inferior margin near the water line intersection.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular dark pigmentation and possible minor edge erosion on the tip of the right lobe; dark scarring adjacent to the central notch on the right side.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant specular highlights and pixel saturation (white clipping) on the lower right and left surfaces due to direct light reflection and water interaction.
